verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe incremental rollout as a product capability. A new deployment can be sent to a percentage of traffic first, then promoted or rolled back, which directly limits blast radius; instant rollback docs back this up. The evidence is limited to brief first-party summary lines, so missing for 10: detail on configuring increment steps and schedules, metric-based automatic promotion or abort, plan availability and limits, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius

citations.quote: Roll out new deployments in increments.
Send a new deployment to a percentage of traffic first, then promote it or roll back.
Revert production to a previous deployment without a rebuild when something breaks.
